name: slider
need: Pick a value on a range by dragging or with the arrow keys

--ds-slider-halo.description: the halo around the slider handle (hover, press, focus), and the slider's height: the base that size and density steps apply to

--ds-slider-thumb-size.description: the slider handle: the base, 4px per size step

--ds-slider-track-height.description: the slider track: the base, 1px per size step

ripple..ds-slider: a range input: the halo around its handle is the press (an input cannot hold a ripple), like the switch

physical..ds-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-trac: gradient direction: the active part fills from the left, as the native thumb moves
